reasoning_trace.value: The paper includes several figures: Figure 1 shows a comparison of recent ISAC demonstrations in terms of data rate and range resolution. Figure 2 illustrates the experimental setup, including the generation of a coherent optical frequency comb and the modulation of the optical carriers. Figure 3 presents the results, including the error vector magnitude (EVM) performance of the 16-QAM and 32-QAM signals, as well as the radar range profile.

reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system uses a photonic terahertz integrated sensing and communication (THz-ISAC) approach, which combines a dual-chirp-based integrated waveform with coherent fusion processing (CFP) to achieve high data rates and range resolutions. The ISAC coupling mode is based on the use of a single waveform for both sensing and communication, with the CFP algorithm used to synthesize a wide bandwidth from fragmented channels.

reasoning_trace.description: Validate the physical consistency of reported metrics (Rate/Resolution).
reasoning_trace.value: The reported metrics, such as the 120 Gbit/s data rate and 2.5 mm range resolution, are physically consistent with the system's architecture and the CFP algorithm used. The use of a dual-chirp-based integrated waveform and the CFP algorithm enables the system to achieve high data rates and range resolutions.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The system solves the problem of achieving high data rates and range resolutions in a photonic THz-ISAC system. However, open challenges remain, such as further improving the system's performance, reducing the complexity of the CFP algorithm, and demonstrating the system's scalability and robustness in various environments.
